|relatedquests = * [[Werewolf Hunters]] |bookcontents = '''Fixxin Followigs''' ''Silvery Blades'' Enchanted silver blades are a must for any would be monster hunter. A silver blade in the gut is the quickest cure for lycanthropy and undeath. Enchanted silver weapons must be forged from high quality ore that has been enchanted by a master enchanter such as myself. A sheet of the enchanted ore must be melted down with an enchanted bar of silver into the appropriate molds and tempered with a flask of water. Weapons crafted in the manner described will be quick and deadly to any supernatural beast in the hands of a skilled warrior. May lycanthropes everywhere tremble in fear from the glistening of silver blades under the light of the full moon!! }} [[Category:Book]] [[Category:Quest Items]]

|soldby = {{ItemWhereTable| {{ItemWhereRow | [[Cabilis|West Cabilis]] | [[Zotalz]] | | (344, 526) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[Firiona Vie]] | [[Fleceal Summer]] | | (-3426, 3327) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[Greater Faydark]] | [[Merchant Lanin]] | | (414, 329) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[Halas]] | [[Rain]] | | (175, -296) }} {{ItemWhereRowVel| [[Iceclad Ocean]] | [[Adinel Jailbar]] | | (4540, 1287) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[Neriak|Neriak Commons]] | [[Andara C`Luzz]] | | (-135, -1062) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[The Overthere]] | [[Tin Merchant X]] | | (2697, 2620) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[Surefall Glade]] | [[Livam T`Lant]] | | (-108, -271) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[Surefall Glade]] | [[Jarse Kedison]] | | (105, 105) }} {{ItemWhereRow | [[Steamfont Mountains]] | [[a clockwork fletcher]] | | (79, -661) }} {{ItemWhereRowVel| [[Thurgadin]] | [[Tavir]] | | (-187, -298) }} }} |bookcontents = A FIELD GUIDE TO FLETCHING: THIRD EDITION Fletching, the art of making arrows from component pieces, is one of the oldest weapon crafts on Norrath. This tome details the construction of arrows, as well as providing information on the sister craft of the Bowyer. Bowyers and Fletchers both require Fletching Kits to practice their trades. Fletching kits can be purchased from archery shops. ARROWS There are four parts to every arrow. Generally, the cheaper the part, the easier it is to assemble. Expensive components produce superior arrows. 1. NOCK There are three types of nocks, differentiated by the size of their grooves. The larger the groove, the easier the arrow is to make. The smaller the groove, the farther the arrow travels. 2. SHAFT The shaft of the arrow can be made from a variety of different materials. The most common material used for shafts is wood. Bone shafts are stronger than wood, and Porcelain stronger than Bone. Steel is the strongest material used for arrow shafts. 3. TIP There are many designs for arrow tips. The most common is the point tipped arrow. Slightly more damaging is the hooked tip - its small blades cause tearing and bleeding. Actual bladed arrows do more damage than the hook tipped arrows, though they are easier to remove. 4. FLETCH The fletch, or feathering, of the arrow influences the distance the arrow travels, as well as the impact delivered upon a successful hit. The easiest pattern to fletch is a round cut. Slightly more difficult is the parabolic cut, whose spin gives the arrow additional flight range. The shield cut fletch pattern has a shorter range than either the round or the parabolic cut, but produces a spin providing superior armor penetration. RESTRINGING BOWS The strings of bows are interchangable and various strings will provide greater range, damage, or quickness. == See Also == * Player Tradeskill [[Skill Fletching|Fletching]] }} [[Category:Vendor Sold]] [[Category:Book]]
